title: mirabilis linearis var. decipiens
intro: Mirabilis linearis var. decipiens, commonly known as the "four o'clock flower," is a variety of flowering plant in the four o'clock family (Nyctaginaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and swelling, as well as fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Mirabilis linearis var. decipiens include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and diuretic, making it useful for treating conditions such as fever, skin irritations, and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-cancer activities.
